definitions.explanation: Related to environmental conservation or products that are good for the environment.

examples.japanese: エコな{生活|せいかつ}を{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: I try to live an eco-friendly lifestyle.

examples.japanese: エコバッグを{持参|じさん}する。
examples.english: I bring my own eco bag.

examples.japanese: エコカーに{乗|の}り{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I switched to an eco-friendly car.

notes:
エコ is short for エコロジー (ecology) and is used as a prefix or adjective.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- エコバッグ: reusable shopping bag
- エコカー: eco-friendly car (hybrid/electric)
- エコ{活動|かつどう}: eco activities
- エコ{商品|しょうひん}: eco-friendly products

RELATED:
- {環境|かんきょう}にやさしい: environmentally friendly
